user.title: Delta Dore Tydom Configuration
user.description: Choose the configuration mode. Cloud mode automatically retrieves Tydom credentials from your Delta Dore account. Manual mode requires you to enter the Tydom password directly. Local button pairing retrieves the local password only after an explicit press on the gateway.

user_local_pair.title: Pair Delta Dore Tydom locally
user_local_pair.description: Use this only for a local gateway when its password is unknown. Complete all fields first. As the final step, press the gateway's physical button and immediately select Submit; do not edit the form between the button press and submission. The temporary pairing window is used once to retrieve the local password; the password itself is never shown or logged.
